IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p64/r2.claim: The great character is the highest and most complete praiseworthy human character, joining all noble qualities and surpassing ordinary good character.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p64/r2.anchor: الخلق العظيم : هو الخلق الأكرم في نوع الأخلاق وهو البالغ أشد الكمال المحمود

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p64/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p64/r3.speaker: علي
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p64/r3.claim: ʿAlī glosses it as Quranic discipline, encompassing the virtues attributed to the Quran and the Prophet.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p64/r3.anchor: وعن علي : الخلق العظيم : هو أدب القرآن ويشمل ذلك كل ما وصف به القرآن

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p64/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p64/r4.speaker: رسول الله
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p64/r4.claim: The Prophet said he was sent to complete noble character, presenting moral perfection as a central purpose of his mission.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p64/r4.anchor: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ( إنما بعثت لأتمم مكارم الأخلاق )

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p64/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p64/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p64/r5.claim: The Prophet embodies his law, which calls people to acquire great character to the utmost of their ability.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p64/r5.anchor: فكما جعل الله رسوله صلى الله عليه وسلم على خلق عظيم جعل شريعته لحمل الناس على التخلق بالخلق العظيم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p64/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p64/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p64/r6.claim: The preposition ʿalā conveys that the Prophet is firmly established in great character, personally and in his religious mission.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p64/r6.anchor: التمكن الذي أفاده حرف الاستعلاء في قوله : { وإنك لعلى خلق عظيم }

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p64/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p64/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p64/r7.claim: The highest character gathers piety, knowledge, forbearance, justice, patience, gratitude, humility, asceticism, chastity, forgiveness, generosity, modesty, courage, deliberation, dignity, mercy, and good relations.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p64/r7.anchor: واعلم أن جماع الخلق العظيم الذي هو أعلى الخلق الحسن هو التدين ، ومعرفة الحقائق ، وحلم النفس

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346/r14.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346/r14.speaker: عائشة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346/r14.claim: Asked about the Prophet's character, ʿĀʾisha said it was the Qur'an, whose commands formed him.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346/r14.anchor: وسئلت عائشة رضي الله عنها عن خلق رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقالت: خلقه القرآن أدبه وأوامره

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346/r15.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346/r15.speaker: علي
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346/r15.claim: ʿAlī says great character means the etiquette of the Qur'an.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346/r15.anchor: وقال علي رضي الله عنه: الخلق العظيم أدب القرآن

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346/r16.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346/r16.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346/r16.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās glosses great character as religion and law; the author calls these its core and essential feature.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346/r16.anchor: وعبر ابن عباس عن الخلق بالدين والشرع وذلك لا محالة رأس الخلق ووكيده

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346/r17.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346/r17.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346/r17.claim: The verse's apparent sense rebuts insanity by praising noble disposition, keen understanding, fine temperament, and excellent natural qualities.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346/r17.anchor: أما أن الظاهر من الآية أن الخلق هي التي تضاد مقصد الكفار في قولهم مجنون، أي غير محصل لما يقول، وإنما مدحه تعالى بكرم السجية وبراعة القريحة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346/r18.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346/r18.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346/r18.claim: The Prophet said he was sent to perfect noble character traits.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346/r18.anchor: ومنه قوله عليه السلام: «بعث لأتمم مكارم الأخلاق»

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r1.speaker: جنيد
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r1.claim: Junayd says the Prophet’s character was great because he aspired only to God, dealing outwardly with people while inwardly remaining with the Real.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r1.anchor: وقال جنيد: سمي خلقه عظيما، إذ لم تكن له همة سوى الله تعالى، عاشر الخلق بخلقه وزايلهم بقلبه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r2.speaker: بعض الحكماء
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r2.claim: A maxim of a sage urges good character with people and truthfulness with God, and says that good character is wholly good.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r2.anchor: وفي وصية بعض الحكماء عليك بالخلق مع الخلق وبالصدق مع الحق، وحسن الخلق خير كله

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r3.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r3.claim: The Prophet says good character lets a believer attain the rank of one who prays through the night and fasts by day.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r3.anchor: وقال صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إن المؤمن ليدرك بحسن خلقه درجة، قائم الليل وصائم النهار»

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r4.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r4.claim: The Prophet says nothing weighs more heavily in the balance than good character.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r4.anchor: وقال صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إن المؤمن ليدرك بحسن خلقه درجة، قائم الليل وصائم النهار» . وقال: «ما شيء أثقل في الميزان من خلق حسن»

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r5.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r5.claim: The Prophet says the people most beloved to God are those with the finest character.

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r6.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r6.claim: Justice, beneficence, pardon, and maintaining ties are included in good character.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p346#2/r6.anchor: والعدل والإحسان والعفو والصلة من الخلق

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p328#3/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p328#3/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p328#3/r1.claim: One interpretation of the Prophet's great character is the religion of Islam.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p328#3/r1.anchor: أحدها دين الإسلام قاله ابن عباس

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p328#3/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p328#3/r2.speaker: الحسن
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p328#3/r2.claim: Another interpretation is the manners taught by the Qurʾān.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p328#3/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p328#3/r3.speaker: الماوردي
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p328#3/r3.claim: Khuluq is acquired manners that become like one's nature; khaym is one's innate disposition.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p328#3/r3.anchor: وحقيقة الخلق ما يأخذ به الإنسان نفسه من الآداب فسمي خلقا لأنه يصير كالخلقة في صاحبه فأما ما طبع عليه فيسمى الخيم

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p328#3/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p328#3/r4.speaker: عائشة
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p328#3/r4.claim: Asked about the Messenger's character, ʿĀʾisha said it was the Qurʾān, meaning he followed what God commanded in it.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p328#3/r4.anchor: وقد سئلت عائشة رضي الله عنها عن خلق رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقالت كان خلقه القرآن تعني كان على ما أمره الله به في القرآن

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p187#2/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p187#2/r6.speaker: ابن عباس ومجاهد وأبو مالك والسدي والربيع بن أنس والضحاك وابن زيد
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p187#2/r6.claim: Ibn Abbas, Mujahid, Abu Malik, al-Suddi, al-Rabi ibn Anas, al-Dahhak, and Ibn Zayd interpret the Prophet's great character as his great religion, Islam.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p187#2/r6.anchor: قال العوفي، عن ابن عباس: أي: وإنك لعلى دين (1) عظيم، وهو الإسلام.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p187#2/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p187#2/r7.speaker: عطية
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p187#2/r7.claim: Atiyya interprets the phrase as referring to great manners.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p187#2/r8.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p187#2/r8.speaker: عائشة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p187#2/r8.claim: In reports through Qatada and Sa'd ibn Hisham, and through Zurarah ibn Awfa, Aisha answers that the Prophet's character was the Quran; Ibn Kathir says Muslim records the long report and will revisit it in al-Muzzammil.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p187#2/r8.anchor: عن قتادة: سئلت عائشة عن خلق رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم. قالت: كان خلقه القرآن

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p188/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p188/r1.speaker: عائشة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p188/r1.claim: Aisha cites this verse about the Prophet's character, then recounts that she had a servant spill Hafsa's food when it arrived first; the platter broke, and the Prophet calmly gathered it and ordered a replacement vessel without rebuke.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p188/r1.anchor: فقالت: أما تقرأ القرآن: {وإنك لعلى خلق عظيم}

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p188/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p188/r2.speaker: عائشة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p188/r2.claim: In another report through Sa'd ibn Hisham, Aisha says the Prophet's character was the Quran; Ibn Kathir notes a similar report through al-Hasan in Abu Dawud and al-Nasa'i.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p188/r2.anchor: عن سعد (2) بن هشام: قال: أتيت عائشة أم المؤمنين فقلت لها: أخبريني بخلق النبي

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p188/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p188/r3.speaker: عائشة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p188/r3.claim: Jubayr ibn Nufayr reports that after he entered upon Aisha during pilgrimage and asked about the Prophet's character, she again said it was the Quran; Ahmad and al-Nasa'i also transmit it.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p188/r3.anchor: عن جبير بن نفير قال: حججت فدخلت على عائشة، رضي الله عنها، فسألتها عن خلق رسول الله

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p188/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p188/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p188/r4.claim: The Prophet made the Quran's commands and prohibitions his settled character, doing what it commands and avoiding what it forbids, alongside God-given modesty, generosity, courage, forgiveness, forbearance, and every fine trait.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p188/r4.anchor: ومعنى هذا أنه، عليه السلام، صار امتثال القرآن، أمرا ونهيا، سجية له، وخلقا تطبعه،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p188/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p188/r5.speaker: أنس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p188/r5.claim: Anas says that during ten years of service the Prophet never said even uff, never asked why he did or failed to do something, had the best character, the softest hand, and the sweetest scent; Ibn Kathir cites the report in both Sahih collections.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p188/r5.anchor: كما ثبت في الصحيحين عن أنس قال: خدمت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عشر سنين

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p189/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p189/r1.speaker: البراء
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p189/r1.claim: Al-Bara reports that the Prophet was the best in appearance and character, neither exceptionally tall nor short; al-Bukhari transmits the report.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p189/r1.anchor: سمعت البراء يقول: كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أحسن الناس وجها، وأحسن الناس خلقا،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p189/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p189/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p189/r2.claim: Ibn Kathir notes that many reports describe the Prophet's character and points to al-Tirmidhi's book al-Shama'il.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p189/r2.anchor: والأحاديث في هذا كثيرة، ولأبي عيسى الترمذي

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p189/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p189/r3.speaker: عائشة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p189/r3.claim: Aisha says the Prophet never struck a servant, woman, or anything with his hand except while fighting in God's path; when offered two choices he chose the easier unless it was sinful, and he never avenged personal wrongs but acted when God's sanctities were violated.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p189/r3.anchor: عن عائشة قالت: ما ضرب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بيده خادما له قط، ولا امرأة،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p189/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p189/r4.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p189/r4.claim: Abu Hurayra reports the Prophet saying he was sent only to perfect noble character; Ahmad transmits it uniquely by this route.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p189/r4.anchor: عن أبي هريرة قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "إنما بعثت لأتمم صالح الأخلاق". تفرد به

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p590/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p590/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p590/r1.claim: God calls the Prophet's character great because he bore his people's painful treatment, opposed them graciously, and dealt gently with them.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p590/r1.anchor: استعظم خلقه لفرط احتماله الممضات من قومه وحسن مخالفته ومداراته لهم

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p590/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p590/r2.speaker: قيل
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p590/r2.claim: Another view identifies the great character as the conduct God commanded in 7:199: pardon, enjoin what is right, and turn away from the ignorant.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p590/r2.anchor: وقيل : هو الخلق الذي أمره الله تعالى به في قوله تعالى

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p590/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p590/r3.speaker: عائشة
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p590/r3.claim: Aisha told Sa'id ibn Hisham, who asked about the Messenger's character, that it was the Qur'an, then cited al-Mu'minun.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p590/r3.anchor: عن عائشة رضي الله عنها : ( 1217 ) أن سعيد بن هشام سألها عن خلق رسول الله

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p61/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p61/r2.speaker: عطية
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p61/r2.claim: One explanation of the Prophet's great character is that it is the etiquette taught by the Quran.

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p61/r3.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p61/r3.speaker: ابن عباس وأبو مالك
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p61/r3.claim: Another explanation identifies the great character as the religion of Islam.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p61/r3.anchor: الثاني : دين الإسلام , قاله ابن عباس وأبو مالك .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p61/r4.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p61/r4.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p61/r4.claim: The apparent sense is that the Prophet has a noble disposition.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p61/r4.anchor: الثالث : على طبع كريم , وهو الظاهر .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p61/r5.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p61/r5.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p61/r5.claim: In language, khuluq is the etiquette a person adopts until it becomes like an inherent form; khaym is the temperament a person is born with.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p61/r5.anchor: وحقيقة الخلق في اللغة هو ما يأخذ به الإنسان نفسه من الآداب سمي خلقا لأنه يصير كالخلقة فيه , فأما ما طبع عليه من الآداب فهو الخيم

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p61/r6.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p61/r6.speaker: الأعشى
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p61/r6.claim: Al-A'sha's verse uses khaym for innate nature, as the habits return to their inborn disposition.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p61/r6.anchor: وقد أوضح ذلك الأعشى في شعره فقال :

MUQATIL:68:2-4/r3.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:68:2-4/r3.speaker: author
MUQATIL:68:2-4/r3.claim: The great character is the religion of Islam.
MUQATIL:68:2-4/r3.anchor: { وإنك لعلى خلق عظيم } [آية: 4] يعني دين الإسلام

NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#3/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#3/r1.speaker: قيل
NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#3/r1.claim: One interpretation identifies the Prophet's great character with God's instruction to pardon, command decency, and turn away from the ignorant.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#3/r1.anchor: قيل هو ما أمره الله تعالى به في قوله خذ العفو وامر بالعرف وأعرض عن الجاهلين

NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#3/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#3/r2.speaker: عائشة
NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#3/r2.claim: Aisha says his character was the Qur'an, meaning its noble qualities.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#3/r2.anchor: وقالت عائشة رضي الله عنها كان خلقه القرآن أي ما فيه من مكارم الاخلاق

NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#3/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#3/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#3/r3.claim: His character is called immense because he was generous with both worlds and relied on their Creator.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p268#3/r3.anchor: وإنما استعظم خلقه لأنه جاد بالكونين وتوكل على خالقهما

QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r1.speaker: ابن عباس ومجاهد
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r1.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās and Mujāhid say the Prophet follows a great religion, none more beloved or pleasing to God.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r1.anchor: قال ابن عباس ومجاهد: على خلق، على دين عظيم من الأديان، ليس دين أحب إلى الله

QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r2.speaker: عائشة
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r2.claim: In Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim, ʿĀʾisha says the Prophet's character was the Qur'an.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r2.anchor: وفي صحيح مسلم عن عائشة: أن خلقه كان القرآن.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r3.speaker: علي وعطية
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r3.claim: ʿAlī and ʿAṭiyya interpret it as the manners taught by the Qur'an.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r3.anchor: وقال علي رضي الله عنه وعطية: هو أدب القرآن.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r4.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r4.claim: Another interpretation is the Prophet's gentleness toward his community and his honoring of them.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r4.anchor: وقيل: هو رفقه بأمته وإكرامه إياهم.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r5.speaker: قتادة
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r5.claim: Qatāda says it is the Prophet's practice of obeying God's commands and avoiding His prohibitions.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r5.anchor: وقال قتادة: هو ما كان يأتمر به من أمر الله وينتهى عنه مما نهى الله عنه.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r6.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r6.claim: Another view understands it as a noble disposition; al-Māwardī calls this the apparent meaning.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r6.anchor: وقيل: أي إنك على طبع كريم. الماوردي: وهو الظاهر.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r7.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r7.claim: Khuluq is the etiquette a person cultivates until it becomes like part of his nature; khaym is innate temperament, and khaym also names a mountain.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r7.anchor: وحقيقة الخلق في اللغة: هو ما يأخذ به الإنسان نفسه من الأدب يسمى خلقا

QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r8.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r8.claim: The kasra form khaym denotes innate disposition, unlike cultivated khuluq; al-Aʿshā's poem illustrates traits returning to their natural state.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r8.anchor: وأما ما طبع عليه من الأدب فهو الخيم بالكسر: السجية والطبيعة

QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r9.speaker: الأعشى
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r9.claim: Al-Aʿshā's verse uses khaym for natural disposition, showing that character returns to its innate habits.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r9.anchor:
وقد أوضح الأعشى ذلك في شعره فقال:
وإذا ذو الفضول ضن على المو
لى وعادت لخيمها الأخلاق

QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r10.speaker: عائشة
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r10.claim: Asked about the Prophet's character, ʿĀʾisha recited the first ten verses of Sūrat al-Muʾminūn; no one had better character, and whoever called him from among Companions or family heard him answer “At your service.”
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r10.anchor: عائشة في صحيح مسلم أصح الأقوال. وسئلت أيضا عن خلقه عليه السلام فقرأت { قد أفلح المؤمنون } إلى عشر آيات

QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r11.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r11.claim: Al-Qurṭubī says ʿĀʾisha's explanation in Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim is the soundest view; the Prophet possessed the fullest share of every praiseworthy character.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r11.anchor: قلت: ما ذكرته عن عائشة في صحيح مسلم أصح الأقوال.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r12.speaker: الجنيد
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r12.claim: Al-Junayd says the Prophet's character is called great because he had no aspiration apart from God.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r12.anchor: وقال الجنيد: سمي خلقه عظيما لأنه لم تكن له همة سوى الله تعالى.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r13.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r13.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r13.claim: Another explanation says his character is great because it gathers noble qualities, supported by the report that God sent him to perfect noble character.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r13.anchor:
وقيل سمي خلقه عظيما لاجتماع مكارم الأخلاق فيه يدل عليه قوله عليه السلام:
" إن الله بعثني لأتمم مكارم الأخلاق

QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r14.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r14.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r14.claim: Another explanation ties his great character to carrying out God's instruction in 7:199; a report says God trained him well through that command, and after he accepted it declared him of great character.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4/r14.anchor:
وقيل: لأنه امتثل تأديب الله تعالى إياه بقوله تعالى:
خذ العفو وأمر بالعرف وأعرض عن الجاهلين

QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r1.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r1.claim: Abu Dharr reports the Prophet's instruction to fear God everywhere, follow a bad deed with a good one to erase it, and treat people well; al-Tirmidhi grades it hasan sahih.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r1.anchor: روى الترمذي عن أبي ذر قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم:

QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r2.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r2.claim: Abu al-Darda reports that good character is the heaviest thing in a believer's scale and God hates the obscene, foul-mouthed; al-Tirmidhi grades it hasan sahih.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r2.anchor: وعن أبي الدرداء: أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال:

QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r3.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r3.claim: Abu al-Darda reports that good character outweighs all else in the scale and can raise its possessor to the rank of one who prays and fasts; al-Tirmidhi calls this route gharib.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r3.anchor: وعنه قال: سمعت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول:

QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r4.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r4.claim: Asked what most admits people to Paradise and Hell, the Prophet names God-consciousness and good character, then the mouth and sexual organ; al-Tirmidhi grades it sahih gharib.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r4.anchor: سئل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن أكثر ما يدخل الناس الجنة؟

QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r5.speaker: عبد الله بن المبارك
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r5.claim: Ibn al-Mubarak defines good character as a pleasant face, doing good, and refraining from causing harm.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r5.anchor: وعن عبد الله بن المبارك أنه وصف حسن الخلق فقال: هو بسط الوجه، وبذل المعروف، وكف الأذى.

QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r6.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r6.claim: Jabir reports that the best-mannered will be most beloved and closest to the Prophet on Judgment Day, while chatterers, affected speakers, and the arrogant will be most hated and farthest; al-Tirmidhi calls it hasan gharib by this route.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r6.anchor: وعن جابر: أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال:

QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r7.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r7.claim: When asked what al-mutafayhiqūn means, the Prophet explains that they are the arrogant; al-Tirmidhi notes a parallel report from Abu Hurayra.
QURTUBI-FULL:68:4#2/r7.anchor: قد علمنا الثرثارون والمتشدقون، فما المتفيهقون؟ قال: «المتكبرون»
